title: Ukrainian Beet Dumplings
description: A bitter and crisp Ukrainian dish featuring demerara sugar, perfect for midnight cravings. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is served on a bamboo tray.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the grated beets, demerara sugar, flour, eggs, melted butter, salt, and black pepper, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place on a bamboo tray lined with parchment paper.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
While the dumplings are baking, deglaze the fond from the baking sheet with 1/4 cup of water.
Brush the deglazed fond over the dumplings as soon as they come out of the oven.
Serve the dumplings hot on the bamboo tray.
